name: blogapp-cicd
description: Root management for BlogApp CI/CD Monorepo

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.test:e2e: start-server-and-test start:test-server http://localhost:3003 start:client http://localhost:5173 test:e2e-run
scripts.build:prod: npm run install:all && npm run build:client
